proposed_widenings.name: on_hit_trigger in ClassFeatureComponentMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Strike upgrade deals 2d8 extra damage on a weapon hit. OnHitTriggerMechanics exists in MagicItemComponentMechanics but is absent from ClassFeatureComponentMechanics. ClassFeatureMechanics only admits PassiveMechanics and ActivatedAbilityMechanics, neither of which can express an on-weapon-hit rider.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Divine Strike. The extra damage of your Divine Strike increases to 2d8.

proposed_widenings.name: on_caster_cantrip_deals_damage in OngoingTrigger
proposed_widenings.justification: Potent Spellcasting upgrade fires when the caster casts a cleric cantrip and deals damage to a creature. No existing OngoingTrigger variant captures 'caster cast a cantrip and dealt damage'. The closest, on_caster_attack_hit, is scoped to attack rolls and does not cover cantrip damage that resolves without a hit roll.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Potent Spellcasting. When you cast a Cleric cantrip and deal damage to a creature with it, you can give vitality to yourself or another creature within 60 feet of yourself.

proposed_widenings.name: scaled ability_modifier coefficient in DiceExpr
proposed_widenings.justification: The temp HP amount is 'twice your Wisdom modifier'. DiceExpr supports a single abilityModifier field (implicitly ×1); there is no coefficient or multiplier for the ability modifier term, so 2 × WIS mod is not expressible.
proposed_widenings.evidence: granting a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier

proposed_widenings.name: prior_choice_conditional encoding for class feature upgrades
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature upgrades whichever option the character chose at an earlier level. No surface mechanism exists to express 'this grant applies only if the character previously selected path X from feature Y'. The feature cannot be encoded as a single honest unit without this conditionality.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The option you chose for Blessed Strikes grows more powerful.

notes: Two mutually exclusive upgrade paths, neither expressible today. (1) Divine Strike 2d8: on-hit weapon damage rider — on_hit_trigger family is unavailable in ClassFeatureComponentMechanics. (2) Potent Spellcasting: temp HP grant triggered by dealing cantrip damage — blocked by a missing OngoingTrigger variant and an inexpressible 2× ability-modifier amount. Independently, the feature's conditional structure ('the option you chose') has no representation at all. No honest encoding is possible until at minimum on_hit_trigger is admitted to ClassFeatureComponentMechanics and a cantrip-damage trigger variant is added.
